integrity: Full proof by independent-subtree splitting and exact induction. Exact-rational recurrences through 80 keys and exhaustive enumeration through eight keys corroborate but cannot replace the proof. All literature comparisons are best-knowledge statements rather than a formal uniqueness certification.
scientific_limitations: Uniform random insertion-order binary search trees only. The same leaf/path-length pair was known to decorrelate asymptotically; novelty claimed is the precise finite-size covariance, the explicit first-order coefficient, and the sharp correlation prefactor, not the qualitative decorrelation. Uniform Catalan trees, other insertion laws and joint distributions are outside scope. An additional relevant source was inspected only at abstract level.
title: An exact leaf–path-length covariance for random binary search trees
